title: Perf Harvest — Standup Digest (cost, dashboard, sampling)
content:
Date: 2026-09-19
Meeting: Observability — weekly perf harvest standup (sync + tactical)
Facilitator: Aisha Banerjee
Duration: 30m
Location: #observability-standup / Zoom

Attendees:
- Aisha B. (lead)
- Marco L.
- Ethan M.
- Priya P.
- Samira O.
- Jeff R. (brief)
- Ops rotation: Nina T. (listening)

Agenda (quick):
1) Brief numbers: cost & span ingestion trends
2) Dashboard gaps and quick fixes
3) Sampling experiment status and thresholds
4) Follow-ups: alerts + rollout windows
5) Blockers / ask list

---

1) Numbers snapshot (last 7 days vs prior week)
- Span ingestion volume: +4.8% week-over-week (spikes tied to model v2 rollout on dedicated).
- Trace storage cost: estimated $7.6k/week (up from $7.1k) — driven by higher avg span size from longer prompts.
- Query cost (dashboards): evening dashboards trimmed queries -> saved ~12% query-time cost on read replicas.
- Hot path latency percentiles (p95) for trace search: 210ms -> 230ms; p99 unchanged at ~540ms.
Notes: numbers are preliminary; Ethan to run the week-over-week breakdown and post to Confluence page by EOD 9/19.

2) Dashboards & observable UX
- Problem: rollout dashboard for Dedicated customers does not surface model variant fallbacks. This caused two on-call rotations to open identical tickets because the dashboard lacked a dimension filter.
  - Short fix: add "fallback_reason" as a dropdown filter on the rollout dashboard (Marco). Target: deploy tomorrow morning 9/20.
  - Medium: normalize fallback_reason into a small enumeration to avoid spamming dashboard with freeform text (PR: telemetry#198 — linked).
- Query performance: one heavy card is doing an unbounded join on traces -> converting to a pre-aggregated materialized view reduced runtime by ~45%. Priya will shepherd this change into prod after smoke tests.
- UX ask: product wants a per-customer token-cost heatmap. We sketched a 2x2: realtime (last 24h) + trend (7d). Action: Priya to prototype card, Nina to advise on access controls for enterprise tenants.

3) Sampling experiment (progress + early learnings)
- Hypothesis: adaptive sampling by request criticality reduces cost while preserving SLO-sensitive traces.
- Experiment setup: two buckets — SLO-sensitive (always sample) and opportunistic (adaptive rates 5–30%). Currently sampled at 18% for opportunistic.
- Early result: total stored spans down ~26% in experiment cohort; alert fidelity for P95 latency remained stable in SLO group but showed 3% false negatives in opportunistic bucket for a specific microburst pattern.
- Next step: tweak opportunistic floor to 10% for endpoints with bursty patterns flagged by anomaly detector. Samira to adjust config and run another 72h window.

4) Alerts / runbook items
- Recent incident showed delayed alerting when the trace indexer paused transiently. Root cause: leader-election jitter + indexer memory pressure.
  - Immediate: add a heartbeat metric from indexer -> alert at 2m missed heartbeats (Marco).
  - Postmortem action: increase JVM memory cap and revisit leader election timeout tuning (SRE + infra). Owner: Jeff R. (SRE).
- Runbook update: add a section for cache warmup after indexer restart (how to prioritize model-variant KV loads). Aisha to draft and circulate.

5) Blockers / asks
- Storage team: need confirmation on retention toggle for GDPR customers — retention API is currently gated behind a feature flag. Ask: Product legal to sign off on toggling for beta tenants by 9/24. (Blocked: Legal review).
- Dashboard team: need a short-term quota bump for ad-hoc queries during the prototype (Priya). Product ops to approve.
- Observability infra: intermittent 503s on trace-write endpoint in eu-west-1 — infra investigating; Marco to escalate with cloud infra partner.

Decisions made
- Keep p99 tracing sampling unchanged but increase opportunistic floor to 10% for flagged endpoints. (Reason: avoid missed microbursts)
- Add fallback_reason filter to rollout dashboard as an interim UX fix.

Action items (owner / ETA)
- Ethan: full week-over-week cost breakdown + upload spreadsheet to Confluence (ETA: 2026-09-19 EOD).
- Marco: add fallback_reason filter + heartbeat alert for indexer (ETA: 2026-09-20 morning).
- Priya: materialized view rollout for heavy dashboard card + prototype token-cost heatmap (ETA: materialized view 9/21; heatmap prototype 9/24).
- Samira: adjust sampling opportunistic floor to 10% for bursty endpoints and run 72h re-eval window (ETA: config deploy 9/19; re-eval 9/22).
- Aisha: first draft runbook section for cache warmup and KV prioritization (ETA: 9/21).
- Jeff (SRE): postmortem plan and leader-election tuning proposal (ETA: 9/23).
- Nina: review enterprise access control model for the heatmap card and respond with constraints (ETA: 9/22).

Open questions / parking lot
- How to attribute cross-service spans to specific cost centers when a single request fans out to multiple models (dedicated + hosted)? We sketched a tagging scheme (request.trace_owner + model.variant) but need to validate with billing. (Owner: Aisha + Finance liaison)
- Should we expand adaptive sampling to embeddings pipelines? Early hunch: embeddings have different burst shapes; need a separate test. (Owner: Samira)

Notes to self / rough TODOs
- Add run-level test to CI that simulates a leader election to catch the indexer jitter case.
- Capture a 1-minute demo video for product on how the fallback_reason filter works once Marco deploys it.

Quick links referenced during meeting:
- Confluence: perf-harvest-runbook (linked in metadata)
- Jira: OBS-4212 (sampling), OBS-4237 (dashboard filter)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/198

Next sync: 2026-09-26 (same time).

End notes (tone): quick tactical week; priority is stabilizing indexer heartbeat and landing dashboard fix before next dedicated model push. Keep experiments gated; no broad sampling policy changes without 2-week re-eval.
